Tested locally (rebased on top of `master` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/1753893c60ac309c21a77201725fa2820caf7f1e), I got a crash while typing text in the script editor. The crash will occur when the cursor is between `{}` on the last line. You may have to type the script by hand for the crash to occur, as pasting the script won't always trigger it (or not immediately).

The crash is presumably caused by the empty expression, as it doesn't occur if you put something between the `{}`.

**Testing project:** [test_pr_103239.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19079203/test_pr_103239.zip)

```gdscript
extends Label

func _ready() -> void:
	text = f"""
	{}"""
```

Tested locally, it works as expected.

**Testing project:** [test_format_strings.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19097900/test_format_strings.zip)

Regarding syntax highlighting, we have dedicated support for highlighting percent formatting and escape sequences in strings. I don't know how much of that code could be reused to highlight the contents of `{}` within strings (which would also be useful for `String.format()`). Ideally, we'd want the content of f-strings to use code syntax highlighting as if it wasn't in a string, and use the symbol color for the braces themselves.

Raw literals also highlight the initial `r` as part of the string, while f-strings don't do that currently. This should be changed:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/11aa7adf-3375-4650-9603-4a670de190c3)

## Benchmark

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** Intel Core i9-13900K
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-5800 C30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 41)
</details>

Using an optimized release export template (`production=yes lto=full`).

Time taken for 10 million iterations of constant string replacements/concatenations:

```
Concatenation 10000000 times: 20552 us
%-formatting 10000000 times: 20295 us
String.format() 10000000 times: 1266809 us
f-string 10000000 times: 23010 us
```

And in a debug editor build, for reference:

```
Concatenation 10000000 times: 129364 us
%-formatting 10000000 times: 129352 us
String.format() 10000000 times: 4091822 us
f-string 10000000 times: 129633 us
```

In a release build, f-strings are a bit slower than concatenation or percent formatting, but much faster than `String.format()` (even when `String.format()` takes in a constant array as parameter). I'm surprised `String.format()` is so slow here – it might be worth investigating on its own.
